# HEM v0.6.2b3 — Door connections, diagnostics and environmental evidence

## Room setup
Under **Windows, doors, ventilation and shading**, the door selector and existing Eco switch retain their b2 ordering. Each selected native door now exposes **Connects to room**, **Door purpose** (interior, fire/safety, exterior), and **Expected report timeout** in minutes. Connections use actual HA Area IDs; contact ownership does not move. All new settings remain opt-in, with no automatic connection or heartbeat assumption.

## Door context
- Explicit, symmetric room connections; only verified open interior contacts form possible air paths. Closed does not mean airtight, and open does not prove airflow.
- Health reasons distinguish missing, unavailable, restored, moved/reclassified contacts, invalid timestamps and overdue expected reports. Event-only contacts default to no heartbeat expiry: a door closed for weeks is not a failed sensor.
- Readable information popup shows contact evidence, connected rooms, temperature differences, high-CO₂/fresh-air guidance, local moisture-removal guidance and warm-to-cool moisture-transfer cautions using HEM psychrometrics.
- Possible paths to an already open outdoor window require verified interior connections and the existing complete outdoor-safety gate. Fire/safety and exterior doors are never transfer-air paths; no door or lock is actuated.
- Quiet context requires independently verified sleep. Recent door activity asks for presence reassessment but never infers direction, entry/exit, vacancy, sleep or intrusion. Existing occupancy authority is unchanged.
- A room diagnostic enum sensor exposes bounded advisory codes, contact completeness, connected rooms and transition hints for user automations.
- Session-only open/closed/unknown coverage and bounded descriptive temperature-difference samples. Gaps and source changes are not interpolated; there is no claim of causal thermal coupling or energy savings.

## Control guard correction
Door Eco now applies the configured local vacancy delay consistently in both planning and live device dispatch. Unknown sleep blocks door Eco. An authoritative occupied-room list retains its existing priority; manual presets, Away, sleep, arrival, PID and native minimum-cycle guards remain authoritative.

## Boundaries and verification
This release does **not** add cross-room appliance commands, automatic announcement routing, occupancy tracking, or energy-savings estimates. Existing device control permissions are unchanged. No AI, new poller or persistent movement history is added; deadlines reuse the existing manager tick. New diagnostic strings are EN/EL/DE, with English fallback elsewhere.

Tests cover exact-Area metadata writes, local/room-list presence authority, report timing, graph cycles, missing evidence, moisture calculations, session resets, passive manager snapshots, native HA entity contracts, mobile popup geometry, exact native editor targets, and b2 menu preservation. Full existing validation remains mandatory before publication.
